name: TiddlyWiki
install: { [ -f package.json ] || npm init -y >/dev/null; } && npm install --no-audit --no-fund tiddlywiki@5 && { [ -d wiki ] || ./node_modules/.bin/tiddlywiki wiki --init server; }
notes: a non-linear personal notebook; pure JavaScript on Node, so it also runs in a browser tab's container
